goal: Let wallet users receive Silent Payments (BIP-352) to a reusable address without exposing on-chain linkage
Delivers the receiving half of the long-tracked Silent Payments wallet project
reviewability: Needs rebase and stacked on two still-open prerequisite PRs, so hold off until those land
A 2026-06-27 review comment is unanswered and the underlying crypto module is externally blocked on an unresolved libsecp256k1 issue
agreement: Sustained substantive support with design pushback worked through collaboratively over 15+ months (josibake, Sjors)
Verified by testing import, rescan, and send flows, with reported bugs later confirmed fixed (Sjors, macgyver13)
Labels functionality is an explicitly acknowledged gap deferred to a follow-up PR (josibake, Eunovo)
Unaddressed objection: hardcoded descriptor checksum and duplicate helper function, no author reply (rkrux)
Undecided process question on whether the wallet flag should be user-settable or auto-set (Sjors, Eunovo)

categories.name: kernel
why: P4 because it only adds a small chainparams data field with no bearing on kernel API stability
Minor, low-risk, and not itself something users notice

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because the RPC changes are thin plumbing around the wallet feature rather than new demanded RPC surface
Low leverage beyond exposing the wallet functionality

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it adds new cryptographic primitives and a vendored secp256k1 module whose correctness matters
Impact is capped near-term since the module cannot ship until an external secp256k1 issue is resolved

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because a validationinterface signature change ripples across every listener including zmq and fee estimation
It changes no consensus rule but needs careful review since it touches many call sites
Its value is mainly as leverage enabling wallet scanning rather than a correctness fix

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it delivers a substantial, long-requested privacy feature with real fund-safety and backup implications
Reviewers actively verified end-to-end fund flows, including change returning to the descriptor
Still an evolving draft after 15+ months of design churn, not yet urgent or released
